prompt: What does setLayout(null) on a container do?
choices: Removes all components from the container
Enables absolute positioning — you must set each component's bounds manually
Applies the system default layout manager
explanation: setLayout(null) disables the layout manager. You must then call setBounds(x, y, width, height) on each component. This gives pixel-perfect control but breaks resizability and accessibility. Avoid null layouts in real applications; use a proper layout manager instead.
